t: Rawlplug fire rated projecting shield anchors R-RBP are reliable general purpose fixings for secure installations. These M8 anchors feature a projecting stud, supporting fixtures during installation and removal, crucial for efficient work on site. A three-piece expanding sleeve provides optimal load distribution and tolerance to varied hole sizes, ensuring robust grip in cracked and non-cracked concrete. Fire rated for 120 minutes, they are ideal for professionals working on critical applications such as installing fire doors, roller shutter doors, security grills and heavy machinery, providing essential safety and stability for construction projects.
b: Three-Piece Sleeve Ensures Optimal Load & Grip
Excellent Tolerance for Varied Hole Sizes
Ideal for Fire Doors & Heavy Machinery
